title: Derived vector anchors for Gubser--Nellore Figure 2

edition.name: Gubser--Nellore arXiv source archive v2
edition.citation: S. S. Gubser and A. Nellore, Phys. Rev. D 78, 086007 (2008)
edition.license: arXiv non-exclusive distribution license; derived numerical facts only

conventions.name: abscissa
conventions.value: temperature T L in AdS-radius units
conventions.rationale: Figure 2 uses an absolute dimensionless temperature rather than T/T_c_plot.

conventions.name: anchor extraction
conventions.value: EPS tick locations define affine maps; ordinates are linearly interpolated between adjacent vector-path vertices
conventions.rationale: This preserves an auditable derived-data route without redistributing the raw source figure.

conventions.name: uncertainty
conventions.value: A conservative absolute c_s^2 uncertainty of 5e-4 is assigned to every anchor
conventions.rationale: It covers the EPS integer coordinate grid and displayed line width.

transformations.expression: (T L, c_s^2) = affine_map(EPS_vertex); interpolate linearly between adjacent path vertices
transformations.description: Convert public vector-path coordinates to the plotted physical axes.
transformations.uncertainty_propagation: Assign an absolute 5e-4 ordinate uncertainty from the integer EPS grid and line width; no uncertainty is used to tune the calculation.
